guide.intro: MC runs on your own machine and has no public URL, so Slack cannot call it. MC opens the connection instead, over <hl>Socket Mode</hl>. That is why there is no Request URL to fill in anywhere, and why the second token exists.
guide.step1Body: Go to api.slack.com/apps, choose Create New App, then From scratch. Name it (for example Mission Control) and pick your workspace.
guide.step2Body: Open Socket Mode in the sidebar and enable it.
guide.step3Body: It lives under Basic Information → App-Level Tokens, not on the Socket Mode page. Generate a token with the connections:write scope. It starts with xapp-.
guide.step4Body: Under OAuth & Permissions → Bot Token Scopes, add all {count} scopes. Copy them instead of typing them:
guide.step4WarnCustomize: Without chat:write.customize every agent posts under the same app name, so the team chat reads like one voice instead of your fleet. It is easy to miss because everything else still works.
guide.step4WarnReinstall: After adding or changing scopes, Slack requires a reinstall: a banner appears at the top of the OAuth page — click Reinstall to workspace. Until then the new scope silently does not apply (voice messages, for example, come back as a login page instead of audio).
guide.step5Body: Under Event Subscriptions, enable events and add these bot events. No Request URL is asked for once Socket Mode is on.
guide.step6Body: Back under OAuth & Permissions, install the app to the workspace. Copy the Bot User OAuth Token, it starts with xoxb-.
guide.step7Body: Bot token in the first field, app-level token in the second, then run Test connection. Finally invite the bot into a channel with /invite @your-app-name, otherwise it cannot read or post there.
guide.docsNote: The same guide, including a troubleshooting list, is in the repo under docs/setup/slack.md.

aiProviders.title: AI providers
aiProviders.intro: Who does the thinking for Mission Control? This page decides, per function, which provider serves the embeddings for memory search and which one writes the daily insights report — plus the keys that go with them. Changes apply immediately, no restart. The default everywhere is your own server; cloud is a deliberate decision.

aiProviders.embeddingsUrlHint: Full /v1/embeddings endpoint of your own AI server (LM Studio, llama.cpp, vLLM — all OpenAI-compatible). Empty = the .env value; if that is empty too, embeddings are off and memories are saved without a vector. Applies to this provider only.

aiProviders.insightsProviderHint: Writes the daily report on patterns, outliers and anomalies across the fleet. "Off" means no report; nothing else changes.
